enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping with the air conditioner running on low to cope with the heatwave night
enriched_activities.desc: Lie on the bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to the left side. Adjust the pillow. Pull the blanket up. Sleep. Turn to the right side. Kick off the blanket. Pull the blanket back. Adjust the air conditioner remote. Sleep. Turn to the left side again. Adjust the pillow. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up and taking a cool shower, brushing teeth and washing up
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up in bed. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the shower tap. Adjust water temperature to cool. Step into the shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse off. Turn off the shower. Step out of the shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face. Turn off the light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, toasting bread and boiling the kettle for tea
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out bread and butter. Close refrigerator. Place bread in toaster. Press lever. Open cupboard. Take out plate and mug. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Open drawer. Take out knife. When toast pops, take out toast. Place on plate. Spread butter. Place tea bag in mug. Pour water. Add milk. Stir. Sit at table. Eat toast. Drink tea. Wash dishes. Turn off light. Leave.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed in work clothes, packing a bag with water bottle and lunch, checking phone
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out work clothes. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on work shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open drawer. Take out water bottle. Place water bottle in bag. Place lunch box in bag. Pick up phone. Press power button. Look at screen. Swipe to unlock. Check messages. Reply to a message. Put phone in pocket. Pick up bag. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital during the hot morning rush
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of bedroom. Walk to front door. Open door. Close door. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Hold handrail. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to hospital. Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Put on ID badge. Walk to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, attending to patients and clinical duties
enriched_activities.desc: Enter ward. Wash hands. Pick up patient chart. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Adjust IV drip. Administer medication. Write notes. Walk to next patient. Repeat. Talk to colleague. Answer phone. Update records. Take break.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating in the staff area while resting in the air conditioning
enriched_activities.desc: Enter staff room. Sit on chair. Open lunch bag. Take out lunch box. Open lunch box. Take out sandwich. Unwrap sandwich. Take a bite. Chew. Swallow. Take another bite. Drink water. Wipe mouth. Close lunch box. Place in bag. Lean back. Close eyes. Rest.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing clinical work and patient care on the afternoon shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to patient room. Check patient's chart. Adjust medication. Talk to patient. Take notes. Walk to nurses' station. Use computer. Update records. Answer phone. Talk to colleague. Walk to supply room. Restock supplies. Walk to next patient. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Write notes.
Walk out of hospital. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to home. Enter home. Close door. Lock door. Walk to kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner, using the induction cooker and range hood
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Chop vegetables and meat. Crack eggs. Turn on range hood. Place pan on induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Add oil. Add ingredients. Stir. Turn off induction cooker. Turn off range hood. Serve food. Sit. Eat. Drink. Wash dishes. Turn off light. Leave.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV with the air conditioning on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Press channel. Adjust volume. Lean back. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put phone down. Drink water. Adjust air conditioner. Watch TV. Stand up. Stretch. Sit down.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a cool shower and starting a load of laundry in the washing machine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower tap. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse off. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Pick up dirty clothes. Open washing machine. Place clothes inside. Add detergent. Close washing machine door. Press start button. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer and phone to catch up on messages and unwind with the air conditioner on
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on light. Sit at desk. Open computer. Send messages. Check email. Use phone for social media. Read news. Shut down computer. Turn off light. Turn on air conditioner. Lie on bed. Check phone. Close eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading under the desk lamp and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up book. Open book. Read page. Turn page. Read page. Turn page. Close book. Place book on desk. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up. Walk to bed. Pull back blanket. Lie down. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Close eyes.

Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to right side. Pull blanket. Sleep. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Sleep.
